messages:
Anika (People Ops): Thanks for joining the all-hands Q&A thread — dropping follow-ups we promised on promotions, leveling edge cases, and comp timing. Post questions here and we'll update the FAQ.

Priya (IC3): quick Q: if someone is on a performance improvement plan, are they eligible for promotion this cycle?

Maria (Comp & Benefits): short answer: generally no. PIPs pause promotion consideration until successfully closed and sustained performance is shown for one review period. Exceptions require Exec review.

Sam (Eng Manager): for managers: what evidence should go in the calibration packet? want a checklist so packets are consistent.

Anika (People Ops): checklist = role summary, 3-5 impact bullets, peer feedback, recent 1:1 notes, and proposed level + comp ask. We'll push a Google template and a Notion checklist now.

Ravi (CTO): adding: include product outcomes and measurable metrics when possible. helps calibration panels compare across teams.

Priya (IC3): are we changing leveling criteria between infra/product? my manager said infra expectations are stricter for IC4.

Maria (Comp & Benefits): rubric is unified, but examples differ by org. We're publishing org-specific examples next week to reduce perceived bias. If you see systematic delta, tag People Ops.

Sam (Eng Manager): timeline check: when is manager submission due and when is calibration happening?

Anika (People Ops): manager packet deadline = May 8 23:59 PT. Calibration panels = May 15-16. Final approvals by May 22. Appeals window = 14 days after manager conversation.

Priya (IC3): if someone is promoted, when does salary change take effect?

Maria (Comp & Benefits): salary effective date = first full pay period after board approval (typically within 2 pay cycles). We'll communicate exact dates per employee in manager notes. Retro pay considered only for admin error or board-approved corrections.

Sam (Eng Manager): how do market adjustments interact with merit increases? worried about double-dipping.

Maria (Comp & Benefits): market adjustments are applied to align bands; merits are performance-driven. We flag employees who would otherwise get both and calibrate to avoid overcompensation. See section "merit vs market" in the doc.

Anika (People Ops): benefits note: parental leave policy clarifications will be posted in benefits FAQ later today — includes pay continuation and top-up details by region.

Priya (IC3): are equity refreshes part of this cycle or separate?

Ravi (CTO): equity refreshes are handled separately from promotion cycles; managers can nominate high-impact contributors via the refresh form. Deadlines will be shared in the refresh doc.

Sam (Eng Manager): appeal process: who sits on the committee and what evidence matters?

Maria (Comp & Benefits): appeals reviewed by People Ops + 2 senior managers (non-involved managers) + Comp rep. Provide manager notes, peer notes, and concrete impact examples. Committee aims to close appeals within 10 business days.

notion-bot: Notes and templates uploaded: https://redwoodinference.notion.site/People-Ops-Promo-Calibration-1770123456

Anika (People Ops): office hours next week for managers and ICs: Wed 11am PDT (managers) and Thu 4pm PDT (ICs). Sign-up in the Notion sheet.

Priya (IC3): one more — for EMEA folks, when will market adjustments be considered?

Maria (Comp & Benefits): EMEA market review is scheduled for Q3. If you have urgent retention risk, managers should flag via the comp exception form; we'll review case-by-case.

Sam (Eng Manager): final ask: will teams get a headcount/comp impact preview before approvals? need to plan hiring.

Anika (People Ops): yes — managers will receive an estimate of comp/headcount impact after calibration but before final sign-off to aid planning. Any big delta will be escalated early.

Ravi (CTO): thanks team. small ask for managers: please normalize evaluation language (impact, scope, autonomy). avoid subjective terms like "nice to have" without context.

Anika (People Ops): closing: i'm DMing the manager checklist and the appeal form link now. Will update the Notion doc after office hours with FAQs. :raised_hands:
